text:
incident-bot: SEV2 - GPU nodepool ceiling hit in eu-west-1. queue_watch reports 310 queued requests, avg token latency 8.1s, autoscaler shows "maxSize reached (45)". paging @oncall-jamie

oncall-jamie: on it. is this cluster on AWS? any recent TF changes to nodepool limits?

sre-lee: checking logs... cluster-autoscaler log: `E0315 09:12:05 autoscaler.go:257] node group gpu-eu-primary max size reached (maxSize=45)`. several pods Pending with `Insufficient gpus` and `0/45 nodes`.

infra-ana: confirmed: AWS eu-west-1, terraform var `gpu_nodepool_max = 45` from cost control. cloud quotas look fine, no recent TF edits.

eng-runtime-ravi: traffic trace: a scheduled long-seq batch from Customer-B plus a synthetic load test spiking chat traffic. KV cache miss rate jumped to 92% which amplified token work.

support-maya: getting customer reports: 19 incidents, 3 enterprise accounts reporting 5xxs and throughput loss.

oncall-jamie: plan: manual max raise to 100 to let autoscaler scale up. infra-ana to perform bump; SRE to watch scheduling; eng to apply routing limits for low-priority traffic.

infra-ana: doing ASG max update now: `aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name gpu-eu-primary-asg --max-size 100`. will restart cluster-autoscaler if it doesn't pick up change.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: ASG update initiated for gpu-eu-primary-asg.

infra-ana: new instances provisioning (spot/ondemand mix). estimated 6-12m. monitoring ASG.

support-maya: posting to #customers: "We're seeing elevated inference latency due to capacity; we've initiated a capacity increase and routing mitigations. ETA ~10m." :hourglass_flowing_sand:

product-sam: flagged for SLA review; please keep updates flowing.

eng-runtime-ravi: while nodes spin up, can we throttle long-sequence jobs? recommend limiting max tokens for non-enterprise to 512 and diverting CPU-only fallback for best-effort traffic.

oncall-jamie: applying routing change to divert best-effort traffic to cpu-backed endpoints now.

customer-alerts-bot: Notified 12 impacted accounts (3 enterprise, 9 self-serve).

sre-lee: pod pending count dropping: 310 -> 170 -> 60 as nodes join. cluster desired nodes=88, current=62. scheduling improving.

infra-ana: ASG reached 88, nodes registering healthy. cluster-autoscaler reconciled new max.

eng-runtime-ravi: median latency for prioritized traffic down to 2.1s; non-prioritized still elevated.

support-maya: enterprise customers acknowledged; requesting post-incident summary.

oncall-jamie: mitigation in place. action items: 1) infra to open TF PR to make the bump intentional and document rationale; 2) SRE to add alert when autoscaler usage >90% of max for >3m; 3) runtime to investigate cache miss and batch patterns.

infra-ana: created INF-4999: "temporary max increased to 100 for gpu-eu-primary; TF PR incoming". Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/2178. Won't merge without infra lead.

eng-runtime-ravi: opened RT-3344: "investigate workload spike & high cache miss; add pre-warm for scheduled large jobs."

support-maya: created SUP-8920 for affected customers and added timeline.

product-sam: scheduling incident review with CSMs and sales tomorrow.

incident-bot: SEV2 -> mitigated (paging stopped). follow-ups assigned and owners added.

oncall-jamie: good job everyone. retro note: consider a small reserved buffer for GPU pools and alerting for autoscaler nearing max. closing thread. :thumbsup:
